# ADR <NNNN>: <decision title>

Copy to `docs/decisions/<NNNN>-<slug>.md` (see `docs/rules/docs.md` for when a
decision earns one). `docs/decisions/0001-liftkit-baseline.md` is a worked
example of this format.

## Context

What situation forced a choice — the constraint, the tension, the question
that needed answering. No solution yet, just the "why decide at all."

## Options considered

The realistic alternatives, each with its actual trade-off (not a straw man).

1. **Option A** — trade-off.
2. **Option B** — trade-off.

## Decision

What was chosen, stated plainly in one or two sentences.

## Consequences

What this makes easier, what it makes harder, and what it forecloses — the
part a future session most needs in order to not re-litigate this.

## Status

`accepted` / `superseded by <NNNN>` — decisions are rarely deleted, only
superseded with a link forward.
